matched AS (
  SELECT t.psp_reference, t.eur_amount, f.ID AS rule_id, f.fixed_amount, f.rate
  FROM txn t
  CROSS JOIN m
  JOIN `<gcp-project>.dabstep.fees` f

   AND (f.is_credit IS NULL OR f.is_credit = t.is_credit)

   AND (f.account_type IS NULL OR ARRAY_LENGTH(f.account_type) = 0 OR m.account_type IN UNNEST(f.account_type))
   AND (f.merchant_category_code IS NULL OR ARRAY_LENGTH(f.merchant_category_code) = 0 OR m.mcc IN UNNEST(f.merchant_category_code))
   AND (f.capture_delay IS NULL OR f.capture_delay = m.capture_delay OR (f.capture_delay = '<3' AND m.capture_delay = '2'))
   AND (f.monthly_volume IS NULL OR f.monthly_volume = m.vol_bucket)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT psp_reference) AS n_txn_matched,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM txn) AS n_txn_total,
  COUNT(*) AS n_rows,
  ROUND(SUM(fixed_amount + rate * eur_amount / 10000), 2) AS total_fees_eur

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT p.psp_reference, p.card_scheme, p.is_credit, p.aci, p.eur_amount, IF(p.issuing_country = p.acquirer_country, 1, 0) AS intracountry
  FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.payments` p
  WHERE p.merchant = 'Golfclub_Baron_Friso' AND p.year = 2023 AND p.day_of_year = 12
),
matched AS (
  SELECT t.psp_reference, t.eur_amount, f.ID, f.fixed_amount + f.rate * t.eur_amount / 10000 AS fee
  FROM txn t
  JOIN `<gcp-project>.dabstep.fees` f
    ON f.card_scheme = t.card_scheme
   AND (f.is_credit IS NULL OR f.is_credit = t.is_credit)
   AND (f.aci IS NULL OR ARRAY_LENGTH(f.aci) = 0 OR t.aci IN UNNEST(f.aci))
   AND (f.account_type IS NULL OR ARRAY_LENGTH(f.account_type) = 0 OR 'F' IN UNNEST(f.account_type))
   AND (f.merchant_category_code IS NULL OR ARRAY_LENGTH(f.merchant_category_code) = 0 OR 7993 IN UNNEST(f.merchant_category_code))
   AND (f.capture_delay IS NULL OR f.capture_delay = '<3')
   AND (f.monthly_volume IS NULL OR f.monthly_volume = '100k-1m')
   AND (f.monthly_fraud_level IS NULL OR f.monthly_fraud_level = '>8.3%')
   AND (f.intracountry IS NULL OR f.intracountry = t.intracountry)
),
first_match AS (
  SELECT psp_reference, ARRAY_AGG(fee ORDER BY ID LIMIT 1)[OFFSET(0)] AS fee FROM matched GROUP BY psp_reference
)
SELECT
  (SELECT ROUND(SUM(fee), 2) FROM first_match) AS total_fee_first_rule_by_id,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM first_match) AS n_txn_with_rule,
  (SELECT ROUND(SUM(fee), 2) FROM matched) AS total_fee_all_matching_rules,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM first_match) AS n_first

  SELECT merchant, capture_delay, account_type, merchant_category_code
  FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.merchant_data` WHERE merchant = 'Golfclub_Baron_Friso'
),
v AS (
  SELECT SUM(eur_amount) AS vol, 100 * SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(IF(has_fraudulent_dispute, 1, 0)), COUNT(*)) AS fr
  FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.payments`
  WHERE merchant = 'Golfclub_Baron_Friso' AND year = 2023 AND day_of_year BETWEEN 1 AND 31
),
b AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN vol < 100000 THEN '<100k' WHEN vol < 1000000 THEN '100k-1m' WHEN vol < 5000000 THEN '1m-5m' ELSE '>5m' END AS volb,
    CASE WHEN fr < 7.2 THEN '<7.2%' WHEN fr < 7.7 THEN '7.2%-7.7%' WHEN fr < 8.3 THEN '7.7%-8.3%' ELSE '>8.3%' END AS fraudb
  FROM v
),
c AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN capture_delay IN ('manual', 'immediate') THEN capture_delay
         WHEN SAFE_CAST(capture_delay AS INT64) < 3 THEN '<3'
         WHEN SAFE_CAST(capture_delay AS INT64) <= 5 THEN '3-5' ELSE '>5' END AS capb,
    account_type, merchant_category_code
  FROM m
),
tx AS (
  SELECT p.psp_reference, p.card_scheme, p.is_credit, p.aci, p.eur_amount,
         CAST(p.issuing_country = p.acquirer_country AS INT64) AS intra
  FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.payments` p
  WHERE p.merchant = 'Golfclub_Baron_Friso' AND p.year = 2023 AND p.day_of_year = 12
),
matched AS (
  SELECT tx.psp_reference, tx.eur_amount, f.ID, f.fixed_amount, f.rate
  FROM tx CROSS JOIN c CROSS JOIN b
  JOIN `<gcp-project>.dabstep.fees` f
    ON f.card_scheme = tx.card_scheme
   AND (COALESCE(ARRAY_LENGTH(f.account_type), 0) = 0 OR c.account_type IN UNNEST(f.account_type))
   AND (f.capture_delay IS NULL OR f.capture_delay = c.capb)
   AND (f.monthly_fraud_level IS NULL OR f.monthly_fraud_level = b.fraudb)
   AND (f.monthly_volume IS NULL OR f.monthly_volume = b.volb)
   AND (COALESCE(ARRAY_LENGTH(f.merchant_category_code), 0) = 0 OR c.merchant_category_code IN UNNEST(f.merchant_category_code))
   AND (f.is_credit IS NULL OR f.is_credit = tx.is_credit)
   AND (COALESCE(ARRAY_LENGTH(f.aci), 0) = 0 OR tx.aci IN UNNEST(f.aci))
   AND (f.intracountry IS NULL OR f.intracountry = tx.intra)
),
per_tx AS (
  SELECT psp_reference, eur_amount, COUNT(*) AS n_rules,
         ARRAY_AGG(fixed_amount + rate * eur_amount / 10000 ORDER BY ID LIMIT 1)[OFFSET(0)] AS fee_first,
         MIN(fixed_amount + rate * eur_amount / 10000) AS fee_min,
         MAX(fixed_amount + rate * eur_amount / 10000) AS fee_max
  FROM matched GROUP BY psp_reference, eur_amount
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tx) AS total_txns,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM per_tx) AS matched_txns,
  COUNTIF(n_rules > 1) AS txns_multi_rule,
  COUNTIF(n_rules = 0) AS txns_no_rule,
  SUM(fee_first) AS total_fee_first_rule,
  SUM(fee_min) AS total_fee_min,
  SUM(fee_max) AS total_fee_max
FROM per_tx

    IF(issuing_country = acquirer_country, 1, 0) AS intra
  FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.payments`

WITH txn AS (

    IF(issuing_country = acquirer_country, 1, 0) AS intracountry_flag
  FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.payments`
  WHERE merchant = 'Golfclub_Baron_Friso' AND year = 2023 AND day_of_year = 12
),
matches AS (
  SELECT t.psp_reference, f.ID AS rule_id, f.fixed_amount, f.rate, t.eur_amount
  FROM txn t
  JOIN `<gcp-project>.dabstep.fees` f
    ON (f.card_scheme IS NULL OR f.card_scheme = t.card_scheme)
   AND (f.account_type IS NULL OR 'F' IN UNNEST(f.account_type))
   AND (f.capture_delay IS NULL OR f.capture_delay = '<3')
   AND (f.monthly_volume IS NULL OR f.monthly_volume = '100k-1m')
   AND (f.monthly_fraud_level IS NULL OR f.monthly_fraud_level = '>8.3%')
   AND (f.merchant_category_code IS NULL OR 7993 IN UNNEST(f.merchant_category_code))
   AND (f.is_credit IS NULL OR f.is_credit = t.is_credit)
   AND (f.aci IS NULL OR t.aci IN UNNEST(f.aci))
   AND (f.intracountry IS NULL OR f.intracountry = t.intracountry_flag)
),
per_txn AS (
  SELECT psp_reference, COUNT(*) AS n_rules, ANY_VALUE(eur_amount) AS eur_amount,
    ARRAY_AGG(rule_id ORDER BY rule_id LIMIT 1)[OFFSET(0)] AS first_rule,
    ANY_VALUE(fixed_amount) AS fixed_amount, ANY_VALUE(rate) AS rate

  COUNT(*) AS matched_txns,
  COUNTIF(n_rules > 1) AS txns_with_multiple_rules,

  ROUND(SUM(fixed_amount + rate * eur_amount / 10000), 2) AS total_fee_eur

      WHEN SAFE_CAST(capture_delay AS FLOAT64) > 5 THEN '>5'

  WHERE merchant = 'Golfclub_Baron_Friso'
),
jan AS (
  SELECT SUM(eur_amount) AS vol,
         SUM(IF(has_fraudulent_dispute, eur_amount, 0)) / SUM(eur_amount) AS fr
  FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.payments`
  WHERE merchant = 'Golfclub_Baron_Friso' AND year = 2023 AND day_of_year BETWEEN 1 AND 31
),
bands AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN vol < 100000 THEN '<100k' WHEN vol <= 1000000 THEN '100k-1m'
         WHEN vol <= 5000000 THEN '1m-5m' ELSE '>5m' END AS vband,
    CASE WHEN fr < 0.072 THEN '<7.2%' WHEN fr <= 0.077 THEN '7.2%-7.7%'
         WHEN fr <= 0.083 THEN '7.7%-8.3%' ELSE '>8.3%' END AS fband
  FROM jan
),
tx AS (
  SELECT p.psp_reference, p.card_scheme, p.is_credit, p.aci, p.eur_amount,
         IF(p.issuing_country = p.acquirer_country, 1, 0) AS intra

    AND (ARRAY_LENGTH(f.account_type) = 0 OR m.account_type IN UNNEST(f.account_type))
